title.narrative: Análisis de empresas del mercado europeo para identificar potenciales socios y facilitar su involucramiento en los proyectos en El Salvador en el sector de las energías renovables

description.narrative: Contract related to: Análisis de empresas del mercado europeo para identificar potenciales socios y facilitar su involucramiento en los proyectos en El Salvador en el sector de las energías renovables - The EUs Multi-Annual Indicative Programme for El Salvador 2021-2027 contributes to addressing the country¿s challenges through three Priority Areas: Digital Transformation, Green Transition and Governance and Human Development.During the period 2021-2024, the Global Gateway has emerged as the EU¿s external action strategy. In El Salvador, it has framed the identification of the Global Gateway Investment Agenda (GGIA), as well as its commitments to address gender equality in all priority sectors, which includes projects of the MIP¿s priority areas one and two.For the smooth implementation of the 2021-2027 MIP and to deliver on the GGIA, TEI, and to push the EU global priorities, such as the Green Deal, Digitalization, as well as EFSD+ instruments, the EU Delegation, MS and partner government may require specialized support to for instance feasibility studies, specialised input for programme formulation or in terms of policy development.This action constitutes the third batch of support measures for the 2021-2027 MIP for El Salvador, the first one being approved in 2021 and focusing mainly on communication and public diplomacy (ACT-60564). The second Cooperation Facility (ACT-62038) for 2.5 M is ongoing and is focused on technical assistance to support the implementation of the MIP and GGIA.These actions contribute to the achievement of the strategic objective of the 2021-2027 MIP for El Salvador, which is fostering the green economic recovery, creating jobs and tackling inequalities, in particular the digital divide. They also bring a valuable contribution to the successful implementation of the GGIA.
